items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: Now see, now Lewis and my daddy, all those guys, man, they played around the basin over there.

ctx.x: Now see, now Lewis and my daddy, all those guys, man, they played around the basin over there. And they had a lot of fun. Loved a lot of homes. And he just had a certain power to him, but Lewis had to ask you to go away, but I mean, he just didn't.
You know if your father would make much money on a gig, say one night he had a job, would he make a lot? Yeah.
